evidence.details: Coworker runner delegates provider, Catalog/View, pipeline, session and ApplicationRuntime assembly to CoworkerApplicationEntry; its AST no longer imports or constructs LLMClient, registry, dispatcher or agent runtime.

The exact ordered eleven-tool view has observe fifth. Navigate returns only route/URL/state/evidence receipt fields; explicit observe records TICKET_READ and a canonical DOM content hash. Planner, browser mutations and SOP require a current bound observation.

Provider attempts, application child run ID and observation binding use one run identity. Application close releases its owned provider and subscription while leaving the borrowed environment/browser/client lifecycle with run_coworker_turn.

Both configs require exact mode 0600. Candidate attempts use a locked/fsynced hash-chain ledger and hashed indexes; the atomic pointer binds exactly one accepted run and the independent verifier rejects truncation, append-after-pointer, cross-candidate rows, duplicate accepted attempts, index tamper and formal verification failure.

Focused Coworker non-live suite: 433 passed, 3 live deselected. Release/entry/profile direct set: 21 passed. Full non-live suite: 1082 passed, 7 deselected, with one existing Starlette/httpx warning. Ruff, compileall and diff check pass.
The unique fresh normal test-set item, headed browser/video gate and real provider verification will run on hkust4 after exact-SHA Git sync; CL-16d final SHA must rerun the same 1/1 product gate.
